item.ptxt: The inspection is performed when diagnosis is started and the MM System Diagnosis screen is displayed.

MM System Diagnosis displays the inspection results on the screen based on information such as each device's response to the "System Check Instruction" and "Diag Memory Display Request" and "Normal Diag Notification".
The screen is an example; depending on the connected devices, such as dealer-installed options, the device names displayed may differ from the actual screen.

If "MIC" is not displayed, it can be determined that the vehicle wire harness or connector between the navigation receiver assembly and the telephone microphone assembly is defective. (For the procedure, refer to )
If "AUX" is not displayed, it can be determined that the vehicle wire harness or connector between the navigation receiver assembly and the stereo jack adapter assembly NO.1 is defective. (see )
